checklist.step: Kick off the annual ORSA cycle with a board-ratified plan
actions: Publish the cycle calendar: risk refresh, modeling, drafting, ERM committee, CRO challenge, board date, lead-state filing date.
Name a section owner for each ORSA Guidance Manual section (1: risk management framework, 2: risk exposure assessment, 3: group capital and prospective solvency).
Present the plan to the board risk committee and record ratification.
checklist.done: a ratified cycle plan with section owners and dates exists before work starts.

checklist.step: Refresh the risk profile for the MPCI book
actions: Update the risk register: underwriting concentration by state/crop, drought/flood/price catastrophe risk, FCIC counterparty and SRA-renewal dependency, private reinsurer credit, operational and data-reporting risk (eDAS obligations).
Score inherent and residual positions with the risk owners.
Extract the top risks for the report with movement commentary versus last year.
checklist.done: a refreshed, owner-scored risk register with year-on-year movement commentary exists.

checklist.step: Assemble the capital and stress inputs
actions: Take the latest quarterly capital calc (C52) as the current-position anchor.
Take the stress and scenario results (C56) — drought replay, flood replay, price collapse, combined — as the stressed view.
Freeze the input versions and record their ids for lineage.
checklist.done: capital and stress inputs are frozen with recorded version ids anchoring the report.

checklist.step: Run the prospective solvency assessment
actions: Project surplus, retained MPCI premium and RBC over the planning horizon (3 years) under base and stressed paths.
Overlay planned management actions from the capital playbook (C53) and show pre/post-action positions.
Document assumptions: growth by state, SRA terms continuity, private reinsurance renewal pricing.
checklist.done: a 3-year base-and-stress solvency projection with pre/post-action views and documented assumptions exists.

checklist.step: Draft the ORSA Summary Report
actions: Write sections 1-3 per the ORSA Guidance Manual using the section owners' inputs.
Show the crop concentration story explicitly: gross vs FCIC-ceded vs net retained exposure by fund and state.
Reconcile every capital figure in the draft to the frozen inputs.
checklist.done: a complete draft with reconciled figures and an explicit crop-concentration assessment exists.

checklist.step: Take the draft through ERM committee review
actions: Present the draft with the scenario results and open risk issues.
Log every committee comment in the challenge log with its resolution.
Update the draft and version it.
checklist.done: a committee-reviewed draft with a resolved challenge log exists.

checklist.step: Run the CRO challenge
actions: Challenge scenario severity against history (1988 and 2012 droughts, 1993 floods), assumption optimism and the credibility of management actions.
Require written responses to each challenge point.
Approve the report for board submission and date the approval.
checklist.done: a dated CRO approval with written responses to every challenge point exists.

checklist.step: Obtain board review and sign-off
actions: Distribute the report through the board portal ahead of the meeting.
Present the risk profile, stressed solvency position and management actions to the board/risk committee.
Capture the board's approval resolution and any directions in the minutes.
checklist.done: board approval is minuted with the resolution and directions captured.

checklist.step: File the ORSA Summary Report with the lead state
actions: Submit the board-approved report to the lead state regulator by its set timetable, via the channel it specifies.
Capture the filing receipt and record the date against the deadline.
Stand ready to provide the report to RMA on request within the deadline RMA states.
checklist.done: the board-approved report is filed on time with the receipt recorded.

checklist.step: Convert findings into tracked management actions
actions: Log each ORSA finding and board direction as an action with owner and date in the GRC platform.
Link actions to the capital playbook and risk register entries they modify.
Report action status to the ERM committee quarterly.
checklist.done: every finding is an owned, dated, quarterly-reported action in the GRC platform.

checklist.step: Update risk appetite where the assessment moved it
actions: Assess whether stressed results justify changing appetite statements or limits (state concentration caps, retained premium limits).
Take any change to the board for approval.
Cascade approved changes into the C53 intervention ladder.
checklist.done: appetite changes are board-approved and cascaded into the monitoring ladder, or a no-change rationale is recorded.

checklist.step: Validate the key models feeding the ORSA
actions: Confirm the capital and stress models used carry current validations in the model governance repository.
Where validation is stale, record the limitation in the ORSA and schedule the revalidation.
Attach the validation status summary to the report pack.
checklist.done: model validation status is current or disclosed as a limitation, with the summary attached.

checklist.step: Version-control the report and its lineage
actions: Store every draft, the challenge log and the frozen input ids with the final report.
Ensure the filed version is immutable and clearly marked as-filed.
Record who changed what between versions.
checklist.done: the filed version is immutable with full drafting lineage preserved.

checklist.step: Log cycle exceptions with disposition
actions: Log any slipped milestone, late filing or scenario omission with cause.
Notify the CRO and, for filing slippage, the board risk committee.
Record the corrective action for next cycle.
checklist.done: every cycle exception is logged, escalated and carries a corrective action.

checklist.step: Archive the complete ORSA pack
actions: File the as-filed report, board minutes, challenge logs, model outputs and filing receipt under the cycle year.
Apply the retention label (minimum 3 years, aligned to SRA evidence retention).
Verify retrievability by cycle year.
checklist.done: the full cycle pack is archived, labelled and retrievable.

testing.step: Verify the report was produced and its scope is complete
actions: Obtain the as-filed ORSA Summary Report and confirm sections 1-3 of the Guidance Manual are each addressed.
Confirm the MPCI concentration, FCIC dependency and private reinsurer risks appear in the risk exposure section.
A missing section or missing material crop risk is an exception.
testing.done: the filed report covers all required sections and the material crop risks, or gaps are excepted.

testing.step: Trace the governance chain to board sign-off
actions: Verify the ERM committee review, the CRO approval date and the board resolution in the minutes.
Confirm the board approval pre-dates the lead-state filing.
Verify the challenge log shows resolved committee and CRO points.
testing.done: a dated chain — committee, CRO, board, filing — is evidenced in the correct order.

testing.step: Tie report capital figures to the frozen model inputs
actions: Match every capital and stress figure in the report to the frozen C52 calc and C56 stress outputs by version id.
Apply zero tolerance to differences; an unexplained figure is a fail.
Verify the pre/post-management-action positions recompute from the playbook assumptions.
testing.done: every reported figure traces to a frozen input version and recomputes, or the break is logged.

testing.step: Assess scenario coverage against the crop book's history
actions: Check the scenario set includes a severe drought replay (1988/2012 class), a flood replay (1993 class) and a commodity price collapse.
Where any is absent, verify a written justification approved by the CRO exists.
Compare scenario severities to the CRO challenge log for evidence of genuine challenge.
testing.done: scenario coverage is complete or justified in writing, with challenge evidence on severity.

testing.step: Verify the lead-state filing and RMA readiness
actions: Verify the filing receipt and recompute timeliness against the lead state's set date.
Confirm the as-filed version matches the board-approved version byte-for-byte.
Confirm the procedure names the path and deadline handling for an RMA request for the report.
testing.done: the filing is on time, version-identical to the approved report, and RMA request handling is defined.

testing.step: Verify model validation status disclosures
actions: Check the validation dates of the capital and stress models in the model governance repository.
Where validation was stale at drafting, confirm the ORSA disclosed it as a limitation.
Confirm scheduled revalidations happened or remain tracked.
testing.done: model validation status at drafting is verified and disclosures match reality.

testing.step: Test that findings became tracked actions
actions: Match every finding and board direction in the minutes to a GRC action with owner and date.
Check quarterly status reporting to the ERM committee happened.
An unactioned board direction is an exception.
testing.done: every finding and direction traces to an owned, reported action.

testing.step: Verify appetite cascade into monitoring
actions: Where the ORSA changed appetite or limits, verify the C53 intervention ladder was updated and re-approved.
Where no change was made, verify the recorded no-change rationale.
Check consistency between the ORSA's stated limits and the ladder in force.
testing.done: ORSA limits and the monitoring ladder are consistent, with change or no-change evidence.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one tracker issue per exception with the cycle step, what failed and the governance exposure.
Assign root cause (calendar slip, lineage break, challenge shortfall, filing miss) and an owner.
Set remediation dates for the next cycle.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compare results to the thresholds: board-signed before filing, zero figure breaks, complete scenario coverage.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have the Internal Auditor — who authored no section and ran no model — sign the workpaper.
File the workpaper and report to the board risk committee and Compliance Committee.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to both committees.

In-scope processes.value: Annual scenario-suite definition (severe drought replays, Midwest flood replay, commodity price collapse, combined events), exposure build from eDAS-accepted acreage data, application of SRA fund/cession terms and private reinsurance, computation of net retained loss and surplus impact, model-risk review and results governance

In-scope systems.value: Actuarial modeling platform for the stress engine, Moody's RMS (Cat Model) for event footprints, exposure data staged in the enterprise data warehouse from eDAS-accepted records

Compliance procedure documented.value: MPCI Stress & Scenario Testing Procedure — suite definition and approval, exposure snapshot rules (post-acreage-reporting-date), SRA term application by fund and state, private treaty overlay, output validation, review and reporting steps

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Chief Actuary and Chief Risk Officer; scenario suite re-approved annually before the exposure snapshot

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Annual — exposure snapshot after the acreage reporting data stabilizes in eDAS; results delivered to the ERM committee in time to feed the ORSA cycle (C55) and the pre-July-1 threshold review (C53)

Deadline reminders configured.value: Cycle-plan alerts at suite-approval, snapshot, model-run, review and ERM-committee dates, anchored to the ORSA calendar

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Chief Actuary signs off remediation of any modeling or parameter error; the CRO is informed where results already reported were affected

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: The year's approved scenario suite, the exposure snapshot, all model runs with logs, the results pack and the downstream uses (ORSA, intervention-ladder review)

Pass/fail thresholds.value: All approved scenarios executed; exposure snapshot must reconcile to eDAS-accepted records within 1%; SRA parameters must match the executed current-year agreement exactly; an independent re-run of one scenario must reproduce net retained loss within 2%

checklist.step: Define and approve the annual scenario suite
actions: Propose the suite: 1988-class and 2012-class drought replays, a 1993-class Midwest flood replay, a harvest-price collapse (revenue plans), and a combined drought-plus-price event.
Parameterize each scenario by state/crop yield shocks and price paths, citing the historical source data.
Add reverse-stress: the loss level that would exhaust the early-warning capital buffer.
Obtain Chief Actuary and CRO approval of the suite and record the approval date.
checklist.done: an approved, parameterized suite including historical replays, price stress and a reverse-stress exists.

checklist.step: Build the exposure snapshot from accepted data
actions: Extract policy, unit and acreage records from the warehouse tables fed by eDAS-accepted submissions, snapshotted after the acreage reporting date data stabilizes.
Include plan of insurance, coverage level, unit structure, share, and fund designation per policy.
Tag the snapshot with its extraction date and eDAS cumulative batch reference.
checklist.done: a tagged exposure snapshot with plan, coverage and fund attributes exists for the crop year.

checklist.step: Reconcile the snapshot to eDAS-accepted totals
actions: Compare snapshot policy counts, net acres and premium by state to the eDAS-accepted cumulative totals for the same batch week.
Investigate and clear any difference beyond 1% before modeling starts.
File the reconciliation with the snapshot.
checklist.done: the snapshot reconciles to eDAS-accepted totals within 1% with the reconciliation filed.

checklist.step: Load exposure and scenarios into the modeling platform
actions: Load the exposure snapshot and map crops/counties to the model geography.
Encode each approved scenario's yield and price shocks; for spatial events use the cat model footprint as the shock template.
Log the model version, data version and run configuration for every run.
checklist.done: exposure and all approved scenarios are loaded with versioned run configurations.

checklist.step: Apply the current-year SRA terms by fund and state
actions: Encode the Assigned Risk and Commercial Fund designations and retained percentages from the FCIC-approved Plan of Operations.
Apply the Appendix II gain/loss sharing tables of the executed 2026 SRA to gross scenario losses by fund and state.
Cross-check two hand-computed state/fund cells against the model output before full runs.
checklist.done: SRA terms match the executed agreement and approved plan, verified by hand-computed cells.

checklist.step: Overlay private reinsurance protection
actions: Apply executed private stop-loss/quota-share terms from the treaty repository to the post-SRA retained loss.
Model reinstatement premiums and any co-participation.
Record treaty references and confirm inception dates cover the modeled crop year.
checklist.done: private treaty terms from executed contracts are applied with references recorded.

checklist.step: Run the scenarios and compute the capital impact
actions: Execute every approved scenario and capture gross, FCIC-ceded, privately-ceded and net retained loss.
Compute the surplus impact and the post-event position against the C53 intervention ladder rungs.
Compute the reverse-stress answer: the loss multiple that breaches the buffer.
Archive run logs proving every approved scenario executed.
checklist.done: all scenarios ran with gross-to-net waterfalls, surplus impacts and the reverse-stress answer archived.

checklist.step: Run sensitivity checks on key judgements
actions: Vary the top judgements: yield-shock severity, price path, fund-designation mix, private-treaty exhaustion.
Show the sensitivity of net retained loss to each.
Flag any judgement that flips a ladder-rung breach for prominent disclosure.
checklist.done: documented sensitivities exist with breach-flipping judgements flagged.

checklist.step: Document methodology and assumptions
actions: Write the methodology note: data lineage, scenario basis, SRA parameter sources, treaty overlay and limitations.
State what the model does not capture (prevented planting dynamics, replant costs, quality losses) and the direction of bias.
Version the note with the run set.
checklist.done: a versioned methodology note with limitations accompanies the results.

checklist.step: Obtain model-risk review
actions: Review the run set against the model's validation scope in the model governance repository.
Challenge parameter sources and the hand-check evidence for SRA terms.
Record findings and clearance in the model governance repository.
checklist.done: a recorded model-risk review with cleared findings exists for the run set.

checklist.step: Present results to the ERM committee and CRO
actions: Deliver the results pack: waterfalls, surplus impacts, ladder-rung comparisons, reverse-stress and sensitivities.
Recommend actions where a scenario breaches a rung (more private cover, authorization reduction, concentration limits).
Minute the committee's decisions and owners.
checklist.done: a minuted ERM committee review with decisions and owners exists.

checklist.step: Feed results into ORSA and capital monitoring
actions: Hand the frozen results (with version ids) to the ORSA cycle (C55) as the stressed view.
Hand the ladder-rung comparisons to the C53 threshold review before July 1.
Record both handoffs with dates and version ids.
checklist.done: dated, versioned handoffs into the ORSA and the threshold review are recorded.

checklist.step: Track management actions arising from results
actions: Log each committee-agreed action with owner and date.
Track to closure and verify the mitigating effect in the next run cycle.
Report status quarterly to the ERM committee.
checklist.done: every agreed action is owned, tracked and re-tested in the next cycle.

checklist.step: Log testing-cycle exceptions
actions: Log any skipped scenario, reconciliation failure or parameter error with cause and impact on reported results.
Notify the Chief Actuary; notify the CRO where reported results were affected.
Record the corrective action and rerun evidence.
checklist.done: every exception is logged with escalation and rerun evidence where results changed.

checklist.step: Archive the complete run evidence
actions: File scenario definitions, snapshot, reconciliations, run logs, methodology note, review records and minutes under the crop year.
Apply the 3-years-after-crop-year retention label.
Verify retrievability by scenario and crop year.
checklist.done: the full cycle evidence is archived, labelled and retrievable.

testing.step: Verify every approved scenario was executed
actions: Compare the approved suite (with its approval date) to the archived run logs.
Any approved scenario without a run log is an automatic exception.
Verify the reverse-stress run exists.
testing.done: run logs evidence execution of every approved scenario including the reverse-stress.

testing.step: Reconcile the exposure snapshot independently to eDAS
actions: Re-pull policy counts, net acres and premium by state from the eDAS-accepted cumulative totals for the snapshot batch week.
Compare to the modeled snapshot within the 1% threshold.
Check the snapshot date falls after the acreage reporting data stabilized.
testing.done: the snapshot independently reconciles to eDAS within 1% with a valid snapshot date.

testing.step: Verify SRA parameters against the executed agreement
actions: Compare every fund designation, retained percentage and gain/loss sharing parameter in the model configuration to the executed 2026 SRA and the FCIC-approved Plan of Operations.
Any prior-year parameter or transcription error is a fail.
Verify the preparer's hand-computed cell checks exist.
testing.done: model SRA parameters match the executed agreement and approved plan exactly.

testing.step: Verify private treaty terms against executed contracts
actions: Trace modeled attachment points, limits, co-participations and reinstatements to the signed treaties.
Confirm treaty periods cover the modeled crop year.
Flag modeled cover with no executed contract behind it as a fail.
testing.done: all modeled private protection traces to executed, in-period treaties.

testing.step: Independently re-run one scenario
actions: Select the most severe scenario and re-run it from the archived snapshot and configuration without the preparer.
Compare gross, ceded and net retained loss to the reported results within the 2% reproduction threshold.
Investigate any difference to a named cause (seed, version, manual adjustment).
testing.done: the re-run reproduces reported results within 2% or the difference has a named cause.

testing.step: Recompute the net-retained maths for sampled cells
actions: Hand-compute the gross-to-net waterfall for three state/fund cells: gross loss, FCIC share under the gain/loss tables, private recovery, net retained.
Compare to the model output cell by cell.
Verify the surplus-impact arithmetic against the C52 surplus figure.
testing.done: hand-computed waterfalls match the model and the surplus arithmetic ties to the capital calc.

testing.step: Verify governance and downstream use
actions: Verify the model-risk review, ERM committee minutes and Chief Actuary sign-off exist and pre-date downstream use.
Trace the versioned handoffs into the ORSA (C55) and the threshold review (C53).
Confirm results in those documents match the frozen results pack.
testing.done: governance is evidenced and downstream documents carry the identical frozen results.

testing.step: Check action follow-through from prior cycle
actions: Pull last cycle's agreed actions and verify closure evidence.
Verify the current cycle re-tested the mitigated positions.
An unclosed action with no committee-accepted extension is an exception.
testing.done: prior-cycle actions are closed and re-tested, or excepted with committee acceptance.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one tracker issue per exception with scenario/cell, what failed and the impact on reported resilience.
Assign root cause (data lineage, parameter roll, model version, governance skip) and an owner.
Set remediation dates; where reported results were wrong, require corrected reporting to the ERM committee.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date, and corrected reporting where results changed.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compare results to the thresholds: full suite executed, 1% exposure reconciliation, exact SRA parameters, 2% reproduction.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have the Model Risk Manager — who built none of the runs — sign the workpaper.
File the workpaper and report to the ERM committee and Compliance Committee.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion is filed and reported to both committees.
